newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: BNZ cuts NZ floating mortgage rate to 10.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: BNZ cuts NZ floating mortgage rate to 10.5 pct.

text.p: The Bank of New Zealand late on Tuesday said it was cutting 100 base points off its floating interest rates for term loans across housing, business and farming, effective from December 2, 1996.

BNZ said its Housing Variable rate would be cut to 10.5 percent from 11.5 percent, as would its Business Advantage and Farm First Variable rates. Its Mortgage One rate would fall to 10.75 percent from 11.75 percent.
Deposit rates would also fall, with the 100-day term deposit rate falling to 8.5 percent from 9.4 percent.
BNZ said short term wholesale interest rates had consolidated at significantly lower levels following last Thursday's announcement by the Reserve Bank that there was scope for interest rates to ease.
